source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper gives finite-sample CRL recovery up to ancestors/parent mixing and defines eta-star as the minimum nonzero eigenvalue over R_X^M for all M subseteq [n].
The article studies score-based CRL, gives linear one-hard-intervention-per-node identifiability, and distinguishes soft-intervention recovery up to ancestors/parent mixing.
Lemma 4.3 uniformly bounds eigenvalue perturbations over all nonempty intervention-index subsets T, in a distinct unknown multi-node covariance model.
The published paper states that one intervention on each latent variable is sufficient for identifiability in its linear causal-disentanglement setting.
The article develops time-uniform nonasymptotic confidence sequences under nonparametric conditions and covers matrix martingales.
